input.title: Product Engineer
input.description:
Location: United States
Workplace: Remote
Employment: Full time
Salary: $170K – $230K • Offers Equity

What you'll work on
• Work with customers to understand user needs, identify opportunity, and translate large, ambiguous problems into scoped, testable features.

• Participate in discovery, solution design, technical implementation, testing, and post-launch iteration.

• Work with frontend components, APIs, backend services, and data models to deliver a complete solution that meets the user need and is maintainable, observable, and performant.

• Build software that is accessible, observable, and performant, with a focus on user experience and reliability.

You might be a fit if
• Experience shipping products in production and working with cross-functional teams to deliver high-quality software.

• You model messy domains carefully and scope features appropriately.

• Clear communication and the ability to explain complex technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.

• You effectively use AI tools to accelerate your work and improve the quality of your output.

Bonus points
• Experience with TypeScript and React on both sides of the API.

• Experience in healthcare, EHRs, or another regulated domain.

• Event-driven systems, where one write fans out to many consumers.

Our stack
Backend
TypeScript, Node, NestJS
Data
PostgreSQL with row-level security, Prisma, pgvector
Frontend
React, Vite, Radix
Infra
AWS (ECS Fargate, RDS, SNS/SQS, Bedrock), Terraform
Quality
Jest, Vitest, Puppeteer acceptance specs, GitHub Actions merge queue
